exclusion_reason: The complete Linux/libretro source and headers are inexpensive (~2.25 MB upstream) and fidelity-sensitive, so they are preserved intact. Only repository metadata, upstream CI, and Android packaging are omitted.
dependency_closure: No package registry. Linux build uses the host C/C++ toolchain plus source already present in the pinned tree.
build_flag_reason: Modern glibc fortify wrappers collide with historical nall strlcpy/strlcat declarations; this preserves the already-green project build contract without changing emulator source.
validation_contract: Build shared libretro core, verify ELF and exported retro_init/retro_get_memory_data symbols, then run the project's independent first-race reference route before promotion.
